units.source_text: 他把明石姬的事一五一十地告诉了紫姬。

en.t: He told Lady Murasaki everything about the Akashi lady in full detail.

units.source_text: 他谈到明石姬时神情十分激动，紫姬看了心中定然不快。

en.t: When he spoke of the Akashi lady, he looked deeply moved, and Lady Murasaki, seeing this, must surely have felt displeased.

units.source_text: 但她装作若无其事，信口吟诵古歌：“我身被遗忘，

en.t: But she pretended that nothing was the matter and casually recited an old poem: "Though I myself am forgotten,

units.source_text: 区区不足惜，却怜弃我者，背誓受天殛。”借此聊以寄恨。

en.t: my poor self is not worth pitying; I only pity the one who abandoned me, for breaking his vow and suffering heaven's punishment." In this way she gave slight voice to her resentment.

units.source_text: 源氏公子听了，觉得非常可爱，又非常可怜。

en.t: Prince Genji heard this and found her deeply lovable, and also deeply pitiable.

units.source_text: “这样百看不厌的一个美人，我怎么竟然经年累月地与她离别了？”

en.t: "How could I have spent so many months and years apart from a beauty whom I could never tire of seeing?"

units.source_text: 这么一想，自己也觉得诧异。

en.t: Thinking this, even he himself found it astonishing.

units.source_text: 因此更加痛恨这个残酷的世间了。

en.t: Because of this, he came to hate this cruel world all the more.
